content:
Welcome to vibe/vibe Builders discord, a permissionless launchpad from the Seedify ecosystem on Robinhood Chain.

This Discord is for:
- official testnet information,
- builder onboarding,
- guild/community coordination,
- project discovery,
- support routing.

Use <#1544667397800075274> first. Use <#1541735369265913899> if you are launching a project.
